title: Offline daily macro metric contracts and brief normalization
objective: Add an additive, offline-only persistence contract and deterministic brief normalizer for the Dune research-verified daily global and chain metrics. This task must not execute Dune, collect live chain data, or activate BSC/Robinhood adapters.
forbidden_actions: Do not read, use, print or store API keys, cookies, browser state, live payloads or credentials.
Do not execute Dune queries, add a Dune client, make network calls, create a scheduler, send Feishu messages, or configure providers.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood CA adapters, collectors, webhooks, backfills, trading, signing, or order execution.
Do not modify existing migrations, existing source files, task specifications, ledger, provider configuration, or files outside write_set.
Do not add stablecoin supply, bridge net flow, global TVL, Four.meme launches, all-chain Robinhood metrics, market-cap/FDV cohorts, or drawdown/valuation cohort collection.
deliverables: An additive migration for macro_daily_global_metrics, macro_daily_chain_metrics and macro_hourly_chain_profile only.
Offline domain contracts and a deterministic normalizer that accepts injected metric observations and emits the daily brief model without I/O.
Pinned synthetic fixture and focused tests.
acceptance_criteria: Every accepted observation retains source, query_ref, query_version, source_as_of, computed_at, completeness and machine-readable warnings.

Only these metric families are accepted: global dex_volume_usd, active_trader_count, btc_transaction_count and btc_fee_usd; Solana dex_volume_usd, active_trader_count, pump_launch_count and external_pool_count; BSC dex_volume_usd, active_trader_count, pancakeswap_pool_created_count and pancakeswap_lp_net_change_usd; Robinhood dex_volume_usd, active_trader_count and uniswap_pool_created_count; and the corresponding UTC hourly profiles.
Robinhood observations must use coverage_status=partial_coverage and registry_version=spellbook:dex_robinhood:uniswap_v2_v3_v4@<pinned-sha>; otherwise reject them.
BSC Four.meme, stablecoin, bridge, TVL, market-cap, FDV and all survival/drawdown cohort metric names are rejected as unsupported in this task.
No cohort persistence table or cohort-producing code is created; that work remains PARK pending a pinned valuation-series source.
The normalizer keeps global and per-chain sections separate and produces no recommendation, ranking score or execution decision.
Hourly profiles require hour_utc in [0,23], use UTC semantics, and retain query_version provenance.
